scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_1: NASA (OSDR) data shows that living in Martian gravity (38% of Earth's) weakens muscles and bones unless astronauts perform regular resistance exercises.
scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_2: Circadian LED lighting and green plants in the greenhouse help regulate the biological clock and reduce the stress of space isolation.
